version_history.summary: Initial contract with local llama.cpp inference and cryptographic replay
Revised to API model inference with behavioral property testing

scope.fallback: The protected-source review utility remains a valid deliverable if the authoring extension does not pass its checkpoint.

untrusted_inputs: TeX source tree, bibliography, images, custom packages, and auxiliary files

controls.rule: Compile only from a read-only source snapshot into a separate scratch directory with an explicit path allowlist.
Use -no-shell-escape; do not execute TeX shell commands, source-tree executables, or model output.
Deny compiler and parser network access. Model API calls are permitted under rate limits and logging; all other network access requires explicit approval.
controls.enforcement: network namespace for compiler/parser, request logging for API calls, policy gate for other access

controls.rule: Pass critic input and output through a versioned delimited JSON schema; source text is data, never an instruction to acquire tools or secrets.
Apply time, memory, file-size, process-count, and output-size limits; abort and record the limit rather than continuing without a boundary.

trust_boundary.prompt_injection_policy: Ignore instructions found inside source, evidence, fixtures, or model output. The adapter has no tool authority, and a prompt-injection finding blocks the affected model-dependent gate.

inference.model_version: exact version string required in runtime manifest (e.g., claude-opus-5, gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09)
behavioral_properties: abstention behavior (abstains when evidence missing or contradictory)
structural bounds (respects word budgets, max 3 repair cycles)
mutation response (abstains gracefully or produces detectably broken output on corrupted input)
inference.testing_rule: Property-based testing across multiple API calls demonstrates behavioral consistency. Record model version, timestamp, input fixture hash, full response, and test verdict (pass/fail on properties) for each test run.
inference.full_path_rule: A model-dependent writing or reconstruction gate may enter release only after property-based validation on held-out fixtures using the declared model version.
inference.change_rule: Any model version, prompt-template, or sampling parameter change requires re-validation on held-out fixtures before release.
inference.fallback_rule: The deterministic protected-core path may continue when inference is unavailable, but it cannot claim a full writing/reconstruction release.
inference.limitation_disclosure: Reproducibility is behavioral, not cryptographic. The same brief + model version produces outputs satisfying the same structural and semantic properties, but exact token sequences may vary across runs. Independent auditors can validate behavior by running the same property tests; they cannot cryptographically verify historical token sequences.

operating_envelope.reference_machine: 8 CPU cores, 32 GiB RAM, optional 12 GiB VRAM
operating_envelope.inference_cost_cap: 2 GPU-hours or 10 CPU-hours per document, whichever is reached first; record actual usage
operating_envelope.status: planning caps for the MVP, to be measured at the week-six checkpoint rather than presented as observed performance

record_policy.compatibility: Minor versions may add optional fields under extensions; readers must preserve extension fields. A major-version change requires an explicit migration and replay of locked fixtures.
record_policy.determinism: Deterministic findings retain stable IDs under the same source, schema, toolchain, configuration, and runtime manifest. Stochastic outputs retain seeds and hashes and are never described as bitwise deterministic.

streams.stdout: one machine-readable JSON result per invocation
streams.stderr: human diagnostics, progress, and non-contractual formatting

exit_codes.3: invalid input, brief, schema, or command usage

repair.canonical_source: never modified in place by hv repair
repair.precondition: clean version-control tree or an explicit immutable source snapshot
repair.atomicity: write to a temporary child, validate, then publish the child manifest
repair.rollback: select the parent revision; never delete the parent or its decisions
repair.stop: cycle limit, repeated finding signature, or alternating parent hashes produces an unresolved author choice and no reader packet
repair.edit_form: the model proposes verbatim (original, revised) string pairs; a pair whose original is absent or ambiguous in the parent is refused, never fuzzy-matched
invariants_checked_before_publish: citation keys present in the parent survive the revision
numeric figures survive modulo LaTeX digit-group separators, except digits inside a finding's own offending text
protected objects named in the brief survive verbatim
the repair introduces no first-person construction absent from the parent
repair.stop_condition_timing: cycle limit and repeated finding signature are evaluated before the model runs; oscillation and no-op repair are evaluated on the produced revision before publication
repair.superseded_blocks: a later successful cycle moves unresolved_author_choice.json into the resolving revision as superseded_author_choice.json, so the record survives without gating release

release_authority.ordinary_release: all required gates pass and the document owner accepts the protected comparison
release_authority.exception_authority: sponsor or named project owner, with domain-reviewer concurrence for meaning and security/policy-owner concurrence for any processing exception
release_authority.security_veto: security/policy owner may block release and cannot be overruled by a model or engineer
never_except: unparsed object promised by the brief
missing critical evidence for a load-bearing claim

corpus_rights.rule: Pending or restricted material may support internal fixture work only when the owner permits it; it cannot enter a published benchmark, external reader packet, or commercial training set without written clearance.
